topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: The box sat heavy in my hands, its surface foreign yet oddly familiar. I traced the lines of the address, each curve and angle a silent story not mine to tell. The name, though not mine, whispered of connections left untended, stories cut short. My fingers lingered, hesitating at the seam where the tape held secrets tight. Curiosity, or perhaps something deeper, urged me to set this box on a path to its rightful journey. I stepped outside, the world a canvas of endless possibility, and placed it at the edge of the road, a beacon for the rightful hands to find. The air, crisp and clear, carried the scent of new beginnings, and I found myself smiling, the weight of the world a little lighter.
